question: When and where was Antoni Gaudí born, and when did he die?
reference: Gaudí was born on 25 June 1852 in Reus (or possibly Riudoms). He died on 10 June 1926 in Barcelona.
contexts: Antoni Gaudí i Cornet was born on June 25, 1852, and died on June 10, 1926. He was a Catalan architect from Reus (or possibly Riudoms), Catalonia, Spain...
answer: Gaudí was born on June 25, 1852 in Catalonia, Spain, and died on June 10, 1926.
